children: Agreement brings delayed and real-time OTC Link pricing to CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited’s Hong Kong clients through its trading platforms
NEW YORK, Sept. 13, 2026
-- OTC Markets Group Inc.
OTCQX:OTCM

, operator of regulated markets for trading 12,000 U.S. and international securities, today announced a market data licensing agreement with CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited, a subsidiary of CITIC Securities International, the international arm of CITIC Securities.

Under the agreement, CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited will distribute OTC Markets pricing data to clients through its browser-based trading platform and mobile application. Delayed Level 1 quote data from OTC Link ATS, OTC Markets’ primary trading venue for US OTC equity securities, will be available on a 15-minute delayed basis from 6:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern time as a baseline offering to CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK)’s broader client base. Real-time Level 1 data will be available to premium subscribers, giving those clients direct visibility into live U.S. quote and trade activity.

The agreement extends OTC Markets pricing data to CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited’s retail client base across Hong Kong, connecting investors with data on more than 12,000 securities quoted across OTC Markets’ OTCQX, OTCQB, OTCID and Pink Limited markets, including international companies from Euronext, LSE, TSE, ASX and other exchanges that are cross-traded in the U.S.

“Investors in Hong Kong are asking for more visibility into their U.S.-traded interests,” said Matt Fuchs, EVP, Head of Market Data at OTC Markets Group. “This agreement gives CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK)’s clients access to key quote data on more than 12K global names traded in USD.”

“Access to reliable U.S. market data is part of how we serve clients who invest globally,” said Alan Fan, Chief Operating Officer of CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited. “This agreement strengthens that offering across our key trading platforms.”

The agreement reflects the growing demand for OTC Markets’ data capabilities in the Asia-Pacific region. In May, JP Chan was appointed Senior Vice President and Regional Head, Asia-Pacific, to lead the company’s growth across the region from Hong Kong.
International companies represent more than 90% of total dollar volume traded on OTC Markets, and demand for that data among investors outside the U.S. continues to grow.
About OTC Markets Group Inc.
OTC Markets Group Inc.
OTCQX:OTCM

operates regulated markets for trading 12,000 U.S. and international securities. Our data-driven disclosure standards form the foundation of our public markets: OTCQX® Best Market, OTCQB® Venture Market, OTCID™ Basic Market, and Pink Limited™ Market.

Our OTC Link® Alternative Trading Systems (ATSs) provide critical market infrastructure that broker-dealers rely on to facilitate trading. Our innovative model offers companies more efficient access to the U.S. financial markets.
OTC Link ATS, OTC Link ECN, OTC Link NQB, and MOON ATS® are each an SEC-regulated ATS, operated by OTC Link LLC, a FINRA and SEC-registered broker-dealer, member SIPC.

About CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited

CITIC Securities Brokerage (HK) Limited is the Hong Kong wealth management platform of CITIC Securities, a leading Chinese investment bank with top-tier asset management scale. It primarily provides diversified, multi-market asset allocation solutions to high-net-worth individuals and corporate clients, with products and services covering multiple asset classes including funds, trusts, bonds, structured investment products, securities and futures.
